senses.gloss:
m. (-षः)
1 A station of herdsman.
2 A herdsman.
3 A creeping plant, commonly called by the same name Ghoṣa, and bearing white or yellow flowers, (Luffa pentandra and acutangula.)
4 Bellmetal, tutenague, &c.
5 Low thunder or the muttering of clouds.
6 Sound.
7 A proclamation.
8 A gnat, a musquito.
9 A term proper for the name of a Kāyastha.
f. (-षा)
A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa): see मघुरिका.
E.
घुसि to shine, to sound, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A cryer, a proclaimer.
2 Ghoṣa, described as a creeping plant, (Luffa pentangula, &c.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-तिः)
A plant commonly called Hātīghoṣa, and perhaps a species of the preceding.
E.
घोषक Ghoṣa, and आकृति shape, appearance, of similar appearance.

nf. (-णं-णा)
1 Speaking loud, making a great noise.
2 Crying, proclaiming.
E.
घुष to sound, affixes युच् and टाप्.

m. (-त्नु)
1 A Brahman.
2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
3 A captive.
4 A cryer, a herald.
E.
घोष sound, &c. इत्नुच् affix, and य inserted.

f. (-तीः)
A lute, a Vīṇā.
E.
घोष sound, and मतुप् poss. aff.
